clippings.speaker: Lana Wachowski
clippings.quote: My brother quickly stepped in, “Look, just so we’re clear,” he says, “if somebody asks something or says something about my sister that I don’t like, understand that I will break a bottle over their head.” [applause] Few words express love clearer than these.
clippings.title: Lana Wachowski’s HRC Visibility Award Acceptance Speech (Transcript)
clippings.context: Lana's Human Rights Campaign Visibility Award speech, recalling a Cloud Atlas press interview soon after she came out; Lilly had not yet come out and is referred to as her brother.

clippings.speaker: Lana Wachowski
clippings.quote: And I would say, though, that as we’ve gotten older and we’ve met other teachers, and due to the kindness and generosity of my brother, we’ve agreed to do press recently on this movie for a lot of reasons.
clippings.title: Wachowskis, Tom Tykwer on ‘Cloud Atlas,’ ‘Matrix’ Sequels, and Out-of-Line Journalists (Q&A)
clippings.context: Joint Q&A with Tom Tykwer on why the siblings, who had avoided press since The Matrix, agreed to promote Cloud Atlas.

clippings.speaker: Lana Wachowski
clippings.quote: “When mom and dad passed, I went to [Lilly] and said, ‘Look, this idea came to me. I can see that it’s about me working with my grief, and I was thinking, do you want to work on it together?’” … “That’s what grief does. Grief spirals us off in different directions… I wanted to go back and feel this thing again, and she wanted to go off and do this other thing.”
clippings.title: Matrix creator Lilly Wachowski shares agonising reason she turned down Resurrections
clippings.context: Lana at the San Francisco premiere of The Matrix Resurrections, as told to The Hollywood Reporter and relayed by PinkNews, on asking Lilly to co-direct.

clippings.speaker: Lilly Wachowski
clippings.quote: I’m out to my friends and family. Most people at work know too. Everyone is cool with it. Yes, thanks to my fabulous sister they’ve done it before, but also because they’re fantastic people.
clippings.title: Second Wachowski filmmaker sibling comes out as trans
clippings.context: Lilly's coming-out statement, given to Windy City Times four years after Lana came out.

clippings.speaker: Lilly Wachowski
clippings.quote: But for me, what makes “Bound” unique and interesting is that it is the start of a conversation that me and my sister are having with ourselves, and that is apparent in the very first shot of the film — which is a closet. So, you begin to understand this idea of two closeted trans women making a film about wanting out.
clippings.title: ‘Matrix’ filmmaker Lilly Wachowski on making movies about trans identity and liberation
clippings.context: Interview ahead of a Chicago screening of Bound, the sisters' first film as writer-directors.

clippings.speaker: Lilly Wachowski
clippings.quote: “And so, like Lana made [Matrix Resurrections] for different reasons… I can’t speak for her, but that’s what I was feeling at the time.”
clippings.title: Matrix creator Lilly Wachowski shares agonising reason she turned down Resurrections
clippings.context: Lilly, at a Showtime TCA panel relayed by PinkNews, on why she sat out the sequel Lana directed alone.
